title: mentha viridis var. cordifolia
intro:
Mentha viridis var. cordifolia, commonly known as Heartleaf Peppermint, is a variety of the Peppermint plant. It is known for its distinctive heart-shaped leaves and its ability to provide relief from a variety of health issues. The health benefits of Mentha viridis var. cordifolia include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to relax muscles, reduce stress and anxiety, and provide relief from respiratory issues, making it a popular ingredient in herbal teas and remedies. 

The bioactive constituents of Mentha viridis var. cordifolia include menthol, menthone, and limonene, which are responsible for its characteristic aroma and its medicinal properties.
